n, m, md = map(int, input().split())

fact = [1] * (n + 1)
inv_fact = [1] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % md

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % md
        base = base * base % md
        exp >>= 1
    return res

inv_fact[n] = mod_pow(fact[n], md - 2)
for i in range(n, 0, -1):
    inv_fact[i - 1] = inv_fact[i] * i % md

def nCr(a, b):
    return fact[a] * inv_fact[b] % md * inv_fact[a - b] % md

g = [1] * (n + 1)
f = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        now = (nCr(i - 1, j - 1) * (i + 1)) % md
        g[i] = (g[i] + g[j - 1] * g[i - j] * now) % md
        f[i] = (f[i] + f[j - 1] * g[i - j] * now) % md
        f[i] = (f[i] + g[j - 1] * f[i - j] * now) % md
        add_value = ((j - 1) * j // 2 + (i - j) * (i - j + 1) // 2)
        f[i] = (f[i] + nCr(i - 1, j - 1) * g[j - 1] * g[i - j] * add_value) % md

dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]
dp2 = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]

dp[0][0][1] = 0
dp2[0][0][1] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i + 1):
        dp[i][j][1] = (dp[i - 1][j][0] + dp[i - 1][j][1]) % md
        dp2[i][j][1] = (dp2[i - 1][j][0] + dp2[i - 1][j][1]) % md
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            c = nCr(j, k)
            val1 = (dp2[i - k][j - k][1] * f[k]) % md
            val2 = (dp[i - k][j - k][1] * g[k]) % md
            dp[i][j][0] = (dp[i][j][0] + c * val1 + c * val2) % md
            dp2[i][j][0] = (dp2[i][j][0] + c * val2) % md

print((dp[n][m][0] + dp[n][m][1]) % md)
